item.title: visualstudio: Visual Studio November Update – Faster Workflows, Better Reviews
item.description:
The November Visual Studio update focuses on reducing repeated work in large solutions, adding MSBuild Restore support in Open Folder, and improving Copilot Chat with a new engine and work controls. It also adds tools for organizing large pull-request reviews plus CSS color previews and IntelliSense.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description:
The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now includes its MSBuild compile commands extractor and runs it automatically. This removes the need for an agent to discover and invoke the extractor separately.

  • Source: GitHub
